title: DELTA: Diagnosing Exploration Lineages via Twin-path Alignment - What Can Contrasting Design Paths Reveal About Microarchitectural Behavior?
abstract: arXiv:2611.31767v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Architects have two mature instruments for performance work. Top-Down analysis tells them where a design loses its pipeline slots, and design-space exploration (DSE) tells them which configuration scores best. Neither explains why a search stops improving: why a backend-bound design rejects a prefetcher that the bottleneck label recommends, or why a capacity increase that helped in one configuration hurts in the next. This paper argues that the evidence needed to answer such questions is already produced during exploration and then discarded. Every parent-child edge in an exploration tree is a controlled intervention: one knob changes, the rest of the design is held fixed, and a cycle-level simulator measures the outcome. When the same edit helps under one parent and hurts under another, aligning the two parents localizes the interaction that decides its sign. translated_title: DELTA：通过双路径对齐诊断探索谱系——对比设计路径能揭示哪些关于微架构行为的信息？
translated_abstract: 架构师在性能研究中拥有两种成熟的工具。自顶向下分析告诉他们设计在何处丢失了流水线槽位，设计空间探索（DSE）则告诉他们哪种配置得分最高。然而两者都无法解释为什么搜索会停止改进：为什么一个后端瓶颈的设计会拒绝瓶颈标签所推荐的预取器，或者为什么在某一种配置下有帮助的容量增加在下一种配置中却造成损害。本文认为，回答这些问题所需的证据其实已经在探索过程中产生，只是随后被丢弃了。探索树中的每一条父子边都是一次受控干预：仅改变一个旋钮，其余设计保持不变，由周期级模拟器测量其结果。当同一项修改在一个父配置下有益而在另一个父配置下有害时，对齐这两个父配置即可定位决定其作用方向的交互因素。我们提出了DELTA，一个基于模拟器的根因分析工具，它将……
tldr: 论文提出DELTA工具，通过将设计空间探索树中同一修改在不同父配置下演化出的两条路径进行对齐，把原本被丢弃的父子配置对比数据转化为根因诊断证据，从而定位使同一设计修改在不同微架构环境下产生相反效果的交互因素。
en_tdlr: DELTA repurposes the parent-child configuration comparisons normally discarded during design-space exploration as diagnostic evidence, aligning twin exploration paths to localize the microarchitectural interactions that make the same design edit succeed or fail depending on context.
